items.quote: Answer format: @is_normal[p_value] where "p_value" is a number between 0 and 1, rounded to four decimal places. @transformed_importance_score_mean[mean] where "mean" is a number rounded to two decimal places. @transformed_importance_score_std[std] where "std" is a number rounded to two decimal places.
items.description: 答案檔存在且三個 key 皆為合法數值、is_normal∈[0,1]（格式；統計正確性不在此宣告）
